title: A new client, start to finish
question: I just got a new client. What do I do?
summary: From the first message to the delivered PDF. You are the only one who talks to the client; Claude writes, researches and builds; nothing reaches the client or gets approved without you.
tldr: Say "new client" to Claude. The `new-client` skill opens a private `Envelope` and writes the questions; you pass them on by chat.
Research and one follow-up, then a `Text Draft`. The client checks only the facts and says OK: that is the `Sign-off`.
Then the design, a `Revision`, your `Approval`, the `Export`, and you send it. Data is deleted 12 months after delivery.

status.title: client-2026-09-01 is at the design step
status.note: Travel & Tourism, a tour leader for Japan. Signed off `draft-02` on 2026-09-29. You rejected the one-off design "Line Diagram" ("super boring! No character, no uniqueness, no Japan in it"), so a new design run drew 18 designs. They wait for their review gates, then your pick.

steps.title: A new client writes to you
steps.summary: Tell Claude a new client arrived: who, which job, which career area. That starts the `new-client` skill.
steps.you: Say "new client" with the person's name, `Rank` and `Domain`. Everything after this is a checklist Claude follows.
does: Claude loads the `new-client` checklist.
It also checks every open client for a stall (no `Export` 3 months after intake) and for a passed delete-by date.

steps.title: Open the Envelope
steps.summary: One private folder per client, never in Git. Outside it the client is only an `Alias`.
does: Creates `private/<name>-<rank>/` with the drawers `intake/`, `research/`, `draft/`.
Gives the client an `Alias` (`client-2026-09-01` style) and writes it in the folder's `README.md`.
Writes `envelope.json`: alias, `Domain` id (`marine` or `travel`), name, `Rank`.
steps.note: `scripts/cv.py render` refuses to run without `envelope.json`, and every `Meta File` in the `Envelope` copies it.

steps.title: Write the question list
steps.summary: 13 questions in one message, simple friendly Greek, adapted to the `Domain`. Question 1 is consent.
does: Writes the master list as one chat message.
Consent first: AI tools and web research, private files, never published, deleted 12 months after delivery.
Optional: a designed Google `Intake Form` instead. Claude writes `intake/form-NN.gs` from the template script.

steps.title: Send it; the client answers
steps.summary: You are the relay. The client answers in any order, text or voice, over a few days.
steps.you: Paste the message into Viber, WhatsApp or email (or run the form script at script.google.com and send the link). When answers come, copy the chat into `intake/messages.md` and photos into `intake/documents/`.

gate.label: Waits for the client's answers, usually a few days.

does: Voice messages need a transcript: your phone's or your gist.
Claude never opens the client's LinkedIn page; its PDF export is enough.

cmd.note: Only for the optional form: run it once in script.google.com; the log prints the client link and the answers Sheet.

steps.title: Consent check
steps.summary: A hard stop. Nothing is read, written or researched until the client's "I agree" is in the `Envelope`.
does: No consent: you decide whether to ask again or stop.

steps.title: Facts and the gap list
steps.summary: Every fact from the answers, each naming the message or document it came from. Nothing invented.
does: Identity, target, each job with scope and results, certificates, education, languages, what may be shown.
Calendar dates are never turned into service time.
The gap list waits for the one follow-up, so the client is asked only once.

steps.title: Scout
steps.summary: A wide, shallow search: the country's CV norms, what employers expect of this `Rank`, how CVs are sent.
does: Reads the `Research Library` first; a note past its recheck date is rechecked before use.
Then the web for what is missing.
Web searches never contain the client's name or an identifying combination.
out: `research/scout.md`: numbered findings with source and date

steps.title: CV Decisions
steps.summary: One line per choice the CV must make: title, length, photo, language, `Template`, what leads. Each sourced, a judgement, or open.
steps.you: Pick which open decisions deserve a `Deep Dive`. Claude shows each with a recommendation.
steps.note: Research is enough when every decision has an answer; a new source that changes nothing is the signal to stop.

steps.title: Deep Dives
steps.summary: 0 to 3 per client (up to 6 for an executive). One background agent per question, each checked by a fresh reviewer until PASS.
does: The agent gets only the `Alias`, never the folder path.
Claude checks the text for client details, then gives it to a fresh `research-reviewer` with its SHA-256.
A finding about a country or `Rank` with no client detail also goes to the `Research Library`.

loop.label: FINDINGS: the same author revises
loop.cap: 5 rounds attended, 10 unattended; then it reaches you as unresolved

steps.title: One follow-up
steps.summary: The gap list plus research questions, in one batch, simple Greek. Then the client is not asked again unless you decide.
does: Chat: aim for 5 questions, never more than 10.
As a form: about 15 minutes, at most 5 typed answers.
Claude updates `facts.md`; anything still missing is left out or marked not supplied.
steps.you: Send the follow-up and bring the answers back, like the first time.

steps.title: Text Draft
steps.summary: The CV's words as a PDF in the fixed house design, First Fitting. Every fact to check carries a copper `Fact Mark`.
does: Page 1 is the `Check Page` in Greek: "check only the underlined facts; the wording is ours; reply OK".
Then the content in the CV's language, sized for the `Template`.
Claude checks every page before giving you the path.

steps.title: Sign-off
steps.summary: The client's "OK, the facts are correct". Not a signature: usually a chat message.
steps.you: Send the draft. Save the client's OK as a screenshot, `draft/sign-off-NN.png`.

loop.label: Corrections: a new draft number; the old one is marked `superseded`

branch.when: the Domain already has a Template
branch.label: A marine client goes straight to the build: the `Flagship` exists.

does: A sent draft is never recompiled; its SHA-256 goes in `README.md`.

steps.title: A design run for this client
steps.summary: Only when the client's `Domain` has no `Template` yet. A design starts from a design, not from code: 18 mock-ups on fictional data.
does: The `magazine-editor` draws three `Styles` × two `Densities` × three `Design Tiers` for the client's `Domain`, specialty and role.
Fictional data only; no client detail in any brief.
The full run, its gates and caps, is its own page: [[design-run]].

steps.title: You pick Style, Tier and Density
steps.summary: Your choice from the designs that passed their gates.
steps.you: Pick one `Style`, one `Design Tier`, one `Density`. Look in the `Design Review` app first if you like.

steps.title: Build the CV
steps.summary: The `new-cv` skill builds from `facts.md` and the signed-off text: no re-asking the client, no rewording beyond fitting the page.
does: Marine: `cv.typ` imports the marine `Domain` with `Flagship`, a `Theme`, artwork and a page plan.
No `Template` yet: a one-off `Template` in the `Envelope`, recorded as a `Framework Gap`.
Client-design previews go to a fresh `design-reviewer` before you see them; it never reads `private/`.

gate.label: Fresh design-reviewer per round on the previews.
gate.cap: 5 attended, 10 unattended, unless you set another

steps.title: Render a Revision
steps.summary: Every render is a new, never-overwritten folder with a snapshot of its inputs, the PDF, its checks and a `Meta File`.
does: Checks: page count, no empty page, fonts embedded, text inside the page.
A certificate expired or expiring within 180 days prints a `Certificate Warning`; it never blocks.
Claude stops here and reports the folder, the PDF's hash, the pages and every WARNING word for word.

cmd.note: Add `--pages 1` for the one-page profile, `--pages 3` for three. Exit 2 means refused, nothing written.

steps.title: Approval
steps.summary: Your act on the exact bytes you reviewed. Agents never approve a real client's PDF.
steps.you: Open the PDF, check it, then approve it by its hash.

gate.label: Bound to the revision and its SHA-256. Refused if the bytes changed or the checks failed.

steps.title: Export
steps.summary: A verified copy of the approved bytes, ready to send. It never compiles anything.
does: Checks render, checks and approval, copies PDF and receipt, verifies the copy.
A new `Revision` inherits no approval.

steps.title: Send it
steps.summary: Sending is a separate act, by you. Then the record says delivered, with a delete-by date.
steps.you: Send the exported PDF to the client.
does: Claude re-stamps the PDF `delivered`.
Writes "Delivered <date>. Delete by <date + 12 months>" in the `Envelope`'s `README.md`.

steps.title: 12 months later: delete
steps.summary: Client data goes 12 months after delivery, unless the client asked to keep it. Deleting is always yours.
steps.you: Delete the `Envelope`, the `Intake Form`, its Sheet and script project, then empty Drive's Trash (it keeps files 30 days).

gate.label: Claude names passed delete-by dates; you do the deleting.
